name: safe-agents-base-rhel-dist
description: AMI distribution configuration for the safe-agents rhel-openshell base AMI. Tags the output AMI with safe-agents:ami=base-rhel so this bakery's AMIs can be listed by tag. Provisioning launches the AMI the operator names by id; the tag chooses an AMI only under the --allow-newest-ami override, which falls back to the RHEL marketplace AMI when no bake exists.
